question: The marked price of an article is ₹1,680 and it is sold at a discount of 19%. If there is a gain of 8%, then by what percentage above the cost price was the article marked?

Marked Price (MP) = ₹1680

1. Selling Price (SP) = MP × (1 - Discount/100)
